title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1955: Fireworks are fun (2)

section.p: An incomparably powerful burst of aura erupted from the mountain, creating cracks all over the mountain. Even the formation around the mountain was shattered by his eruption of power. The backlash caused Great Ming King to cough a mouthful of blood. There was nothing he could do about that.
The powerful fluctuations were now free to spread further away. The concealment formation was no more. It was only natural that Great Ming King couldn’t stop Hundred Battle King’s outburst.
“Hahaha!”
The overjoyed Hundred Battle King roared with laughter and said, “A little rat like you dare to sleep at the same place as me?”
Hundred Battle King threw a punch at the ground.

The mountain was blasted apart. An intense life force surged into the sky. Even with the final layer of seal on him, Hundred Battle King was able to deploy an incredible amount of strength. With one punch, he turned a mountain into an abyss. Inside the abyss was a newly awakened devil who was just about to step through a door. Noticing the changes around him, the devil stopped.

He was about to teleport himself out, but Hundred Battle King had punched the way clear for him, rendering teleportation pointless. The newly awakened Celestial Devil Marquis was faced with the newly freed Hundred Battle King.

A smile formed on the ancient face of Celestial Devil Marquis as he said, “You’re really free. Unfortunately for you, the final seal remains. I know you, Hundred Battle, even if we have never fought before.”
“You talk too much. Just die.”
Hundred Battle King threw another punch, a punch that caused the world itself to shake.
Facing the incoming punch, the final bit of grogginess faded away from Celestial Devil Marquis’ mind. His face turned solemn.
Hundred Battle King. Truly an incredible person.

He manifested a spear and swept it toward the fist. The two attacks clashed. Everything had happened in the blink of an eye. The clash created another explosion, creating a hole ten thousand meters deep in the ground.
Hundred Battle King roared with laughter and said, “I’m free! Wait for me! Kill the other two! I’ll kill this old fart, and we can have some fun with the others!”
Great Zhou King’s group ignored him and regrouped around Su Yu instead. Su Yu was the one in charge today. And Su Yu was ignoring Hundred Battle King.
What a fool.
He was uninterested in having any fun here. What was the point of killing more heavenly kings? It wouldn’t do much.
He looked around with his Heaven Gate. He noticed several Daofuses moving rapidly in their direction, but he was unconcerned about them. But next, his heart thumped violently.
Sure enough!
Hundred Battle King had created too big of a ruckus. Two of the super-powerful daos he had seen previously were now heading toward them.
One belonged to the super expert on a mountain.
One belonged to a domineering expert residing atop a river.
Both were heading in their direction.

The dao of Heavenly Fate Marquis flickered slightly as well, but after a slight pause, it calmed down again. Clearly, he had considered moving as well before deciding against it. March’s dao was flickering slightly as well. Eventually, the dao started moving. Clearly, he had decided to approach after sensing that Hundred Battle King was out.
Next, Su Yu noticed the approach of another dao. That was the dao of a super expert he had not noticed before, the expert who was buried underground.
Five super experts.
Apart from Heavenly Fate Marquis, the rest were all approaching them.
Their voice arrived first.
“Celestial Devil, keep him occupied.”
A cold voice commanded from afar.
Keeping Hundred Battle King occupied.
They couldn’t allow him to flee.

Hundred Battle King, who was happily punching the devil in the abyss, cursed under his breath. All these bastards were nearby. Just as he was about to flee, Celestial Devil Marquis laughed and started attacking.

Celestial Devil Marquis was a super expert as well. As Hundred Battle King wasn’t fully free, he only held a slight advantage over Celestial Devil Marquis. Therefore, it also wouldn’t be easy for him to break free when Celestial Devil Marquis was focusing on keeping him busy.

At the same time, Dao Yu and Blood Devil had grouped up. Both looked pale. Their emotions had undergone countless changes in a short time. They were shocked at how easily the six heavenly kings had died. They were shocked at the fact that Hundred Battle King was really out. But they were also rejoicing at the fact that this was still their territory. Several super experts were showing up to help.

They were all rushing over rapidly. Great Zhou King and the others looked nervous. Not much joy could be seen on their faces even after killing six heavenly kings. They could sense that more experts were approaching. They were too busy worrying about the approaching experts to celebrate.

All of them looked at Su Yu for instructions on what to do. Should they escape now? This was probably their final chance to flee. They had killed enough people today. As for Hundred Battle King, well, there was nothing they could do about him.
“Thirty seconds.”
Of the various approaching experts, the closest was the expert from the ground. He would arrive in about thirty seconds. Dao Yu and Blood Devil weren’t so easy to kill.
Su Yu looked at Hundred Battle King. He narrowed his eyes and roared, “Hundred Battle King, Lord Yue Luo is awaiting your return! Withdraw immediately!”
“Yue Luo?”
“Roar!”

At the mention of that name, Hundred Battle King roared like a wild beast. He even started fighting like a beast, delivering numerous punches to Celestial Devil Marquis, causing the devil marquis to cough a large amount of blood.
That was not all. Hundred Battle King’s eyes had turned red, as though he was on the verge of losing his mind.
Yue Luo.
Were these people sent by Yue Luo?
No!
He recognized Stable Army Marquis and a few others. Had they all submitted to Yue Luo?
“Did Yue Luo send you here?”
He demanded furiously. Did she send them here? However, Su Yu was completely ignoring him after that. He wouldn’t mind seeing Hundred Battle King resist more.
“Formation.”
With one order from Su Yu, Great Ming King laid down a formation even as he was still coughing blood.
Clearly, that was a formation Hundred Battle King recognized. The moment it appeared, he roared, “You’re really with her! Stable Army, have you betrayed me as well?”

Stable Army Marquis cursed inwardly. Was he crazy? What the fuck was he talking about? Stable Army Marquis didn’t even know what was going on. He only knew that Hundred Battle King was already free. Why was the guy still picking faults with them?

This time, Great Ming King had placed down a smaller formation that covered only their immediate surroundings. He knew Su Yu well. Since Su Yu was calling for a formation now, he was clearly targeting the two heavenly kings before them.
Dao Yu and Blood Devil were shocked to see what they were doing.
Dao Yu roared with disbelief, “Are you mad? Don’t you want to keep living?”
The other experts would arrive soon.

These people should be grateful that the two of them weren’t attacking. But instead of fleeing, these people were thinking of attacking? Were they crazy? Did the two of them look anything like easy targets? The super experts nearby would be here soon.

Based on Dao Yu’s logic, these people should be fleeing instead. Su Yu couldn’t be bothered to say anything to them. Noticing Su Yu’s reaction, Great Zhou King’s heart thumped nervously. Was Su Yu thinking of killing these two as well?
Would they have enough time to flee after that? However, he was well aware that they only stood a chance by following Su Yu’s orders. A ruthless gleam flickered in Su Yu’s eyes.
The Mark of Civilization appeared.
Instead of releasing West Royal Consort, he tore the back cover off; the cover West Royal Consort was sealed in. He had decided to abandon this cover. He could always forge a new cover for his book.
At the same time, he took the Token of Sanctification out. That was a true treasure left behind by Culture King to deal with Martial Emperor. Who was Martial Emperor? A Master of Law.
The moment the Token of Sanctification appeared, it shot toward the two heavenly kings.
“Die!”
Su Yu roared.
At the same time, a saintly power erupted from the Token of Sanctification. A grand voice rang out in the air, “Submit.”

That seemed to be Culture King’s voice. A voice capable of suppressing everything. Alarmed, Dao Yu and Blood Devil ignited their blood essence. They intended to drag the battle out until the super experts arrived.
But just then, confusion flickered in their eyes.
Submission.
They were being told to submit.
That was the sole thought in their mind.
They had to submit.

At the same time, Great Zhou King pushed his patient dao to its limit, further increasing the confusion of the two heavenly kings. The two could only react instinctively. With a wave of Su Yu’s hand, the little stone descended upon the two. Everything had happened instantly.

The two were heavenly kings. Even in a state of confusion, their bodies would react automatically against any incoming attacks. And when the attacks reached a certain intensity, they might even recover from their confusion.
Su Yu had the torn cover in hand. He withdrew the characters imprinted on the page.
At the same time, West Royal Consort was sensing that something was off.

For some reason, the space around her had loosened considerably. She could even sense her dao now. She was greatly surprised. Were her people here to rescue her? Well, that was fast. But they needed time and opportunity to enter the Lower Realm, right?
But next, West Royal Consort’s expression changed. She could sense how intense her dao was shaking. Su Yu had kept her separate from her dao for so long. Had he done something to her dao?

That was likely. As someone with the Heaven Gate open, Su Yu could easily do something to the dao of others. West Royal Consort sank into hesitation. Should she break free now? Before she could decide on anything, an intense power of detonation encroached upon her.
Her expression changed drastically.
Damn it!
Was Su Yu trying to die together with her?
Was he trying to kill her?
“Break!”

Left with no choice, she decided to grab the chance and break free. Outside, Su Yu had just tossed the cover toward the two heavenly kings. Then, he manifested his pen dao and swung it as a saber. The saber was aimed toward three targets.

Both Dao Yu and Blood Devil could sense the arrival of an intense crisis. At the same time, Lan Tian and the others were also attacking with all their strength. And finally, Dao Yu and Blood Devil recovered from their confusion.

When their gaze landed on the incoming cover, their expressions changed. They recalled what happened earlier with South Suppression Marquis. And they could sense that there was someone inside this cover. An extremely powerful person.

They were definitely planning to do the same thing! The person inside the page would definitely detonate themselves after coming out! They still remembered clearly how the previous heavenly king had died. With a roar, Dao Yu broke free from the suppression of the Token of Sanctification.
“Kill! We can’t allow this person to self-detonate!”

After witnessing the same trick with their own eyes, they naturally wouldn’t fall for it. This was a terrifying organization. South Suppression Marquis had detonated himself without any hesitation. They had no doubt that the person inside the cover would be just as decisive.

And thus, the two attacked the cover with all their strength. The cover crumbled apart, revealing West Royal Consort, whose expression was changing drastically. She had broken free just to be faced with the attacks of two heavenly kings.

She wasn’t given the chance to think about it. She couldn’t escape in time. She was left with only one option. She had to resist the incoming attack head-on. Her current body was still rather weak, but she still had the power of her dao. As her dao shook violently, a powerful aura surged, carrying with it an intense power of sealing.
She was aiming to seal both her opponents.
Just as she was done summoning her power, the two attacks struck her body and turned it into ash. Her dao continued trembling violently. She was able to complete her attack before losing her body.

Instantly, the sealing power landed on Dao Yu and Blood Devil. At the same time, the bombardment from Su Yu’s group arrived. All of them were fighting at full strength. As the attacks landed, Su Yu roared.
“Lord Zi Yan!”
